extracted.name: Easy Homemade Salsa
extracted.description: This easy Homemade Salsa recipe takes just 5 minutes to make in a food processor and tastes better than restaurant salsa with simple ingredients like canned tomatoes, cilantro, lime juice, and Rotel. Make a big batch of this fresh Mexican salsa for just a few dollars and serve it with chips, tacos, or breakfast eggs all week long.
ingredient_lines: 28 ounce can whole peeled tomatoes (, slightly drained)
2 (10 oz) cans diced tomatoes with green chiles (, undrained)
1/2 teaspoon sea salt (, or more, to taste)
instruction_lines: Add all ingredients to a food processor and pulse a few times until no large chunks remain.
Taste and adjust seasonings, if needed, to taste.
For best flavor, refrigerate salsa for at least 1-2 hours before serving. Store in the fridge for up to 1 week.
This recipe makes a little less than 6 cups of salsa. I like to fill 3 pint jars and and share with friends and neighbors.
